blockers.title_at_research: Adopt sfx_drum_bandpass for Nineteen (the hi-hat band-pass toggle; aud .9082 -> .9168, moves Nineteen only)
blockers.current_behaviour: presets.json songs['Nineteen.sid'] has no sfx_drum_bandpass key, so the existing goatwriter.sfx_bandpass_plan emitter is off and Nineteen never leaves low-pass (original 1367 band-pass frames in 180 s, ours 0). fix.patch passes git apply --check at fa646bb.

options.label: Adopt
options.consequence: Nineteen aud .9082 -> .9168 (+.0086, under the 0.0095 corpus floor), band 84 -> 86%, bnote 0 -> 99%, 98.7% of the original's band-pass frames matched in phase; one preset key and three test files; Nineteen only

options.label: Drop
options.consequence: Nineteen stays low-pass on every hat frame; the finding stays a finding

blockers.why: The aud gain alone sits under the noise floor, but the register columns show the conversion now does what the player does (bnote 0 -> 99%, band-pass frames in phase), nothing falls, and presets.py --fidelity chose the same key independently.
blockers.auto_adopt_failed_on: aud rise .0086 is below the 0.0095 noise floor (docs/SOUND-CALIBRATION.md); Nineteen has no per-file calibration
blockers.question: Adopt the hi-hat band-pass toggle for Nineteen?
